tagline: Making quality housing, whether rented or owned, accessible to all American households.
hero_kpi_rationale: Record growth of mortgage banking platforms (Sequoia and CoreVest) is the primary driver of Redwood's strategic transition toward a more efficient and predictable business model.

kpis.name: Mortgage banking platforms production
kpis.explanation: Total volume of loans originated or acquired by mortgage banking platforms.
kpis.description: Represents the sum of loan volumes locked by Sequoia ($20.7 billion) and funded by CoreVest ($2.0 billion) for the 2025 fiscal year.
kpis.signal: Doubling of production, signaling market share gains and successful strategy execution.

kpis.name: Sequoia platform market share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of the jumbo mortgage loan market captured by the Sequoia platform.
kpis.description: Indicates Sequoia's competitive position in the jumbo mortgage market (large-balance loans).
kpis.signal: Significant market share gain in the jumbo segment, expanding from 4.3% to 7.0%.

kpis.name: Aspire platform volume
kpis.explanation: Volume of loans originated by Aspire, the expanded-credit and non-QM lending platform.
kpis.description: Loan volume generated by Aspire, which focuses on expanded-credit and non-QM loans (loans not meeting standard underwriting criteria).
kpis.signal: Rapid growth of the Aspire platform, reaching $3.2 billion in 2025.

kpis.name: Legacy investments portfolio reduction
kpis.explanation: Decrease in the proportion of assets classified as legacy within the total portfolio.
kpis.description: Indicates progress in disposing or restructuring less strategic assets to simplify the operating model.
kpis.signal: Significant reduction of the Legacy Investments portfolio (from 33% to 19%) to focus on core activities.

kpis.name: Cost per loan
kpis.explanation: Operating cost for each originated loan, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Measures the efficiency of mortgage banking operations, calculated as operating expenses divided by loan purchase commitments, with decline driven by operating leverage and cost management.
kpis.signal: Improvement in operational efficiency with a 21% decline in cost per loan.

kpis.name: Capital allocation to mortgage banking platforms
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total capital allocated to mortgage banking platforms.
kpis.description: Shows capital shifting toward Sequoia and Redwood Investments platforms, aligned with the originate-to-distribute model.
kpis.signal: Increased capital concentration in mortgage banking activities, reflecting strategic refocus.

kpis.name: CoreVest funded volume growth
kpis.explanation: Volume of loans funded by the CoreVest platform in 2025.
kpis.description: Loan volume of $2.0 billion generated by CoreVest in 2025, with growing emphasis on smaller-balance products such as RTL and DSCR. Year-over-year growth of 13% reflects expansion of the professional-use lending portfolio.
kpis.signal: Continued CoreVest growth in funding loans to real estate investors.

kpis.name: Senior unsecured debt issued
kpis.explanation: Amount of new senior unsecured debt issued by the company.
kpis.description: Amount of senior unsecured debt issued in 2025 as part of capital structure management.
kpis.signal: Debt issuance to strengthen capital structure and fund operating activities.

kpis.name: Common stock repurchased
kpis.explanation: Amount of common stock repurchased by the company.
kpis.description: Amount of common stock repurchased in 2025, contributing to approximately $0.13 per share increase in book value per share.
kpis.signal: Share repurchases to return value to shareholders and enhance per-share value.

kpis.name: Sequoia Q4 2025 lock volume
kpis.explanation: Volume of loans locked by Sequoia in the fourth quarter of 2025.
kpis.description: Volume of $6.8 billion in loans locked by Sequoia in Q4 2025, including Aspire activity, representing a 193% increase compared to Q4 2024.
kpis.signal: Record acceleration in Sequoia production in the fourth quarter, reflecting strong market momentum and market share gains.

kpis.name: Sequoia full year 2025 lock volume
kpis.explanation: Total annual volume of loans locked by Sequoia in 2025.
kpis.description: Annual volume of $20.7 billion in loans locked by Sequoia in 2025, representing substantial growth and establishing a new record for the platform.
kpis.signal: Record Sequoia production reflecting capture of non-agency mortgage market growth and market share gains.

kpis.name: Aspire Q4 2025 lock volume
kpis.explanation: Volume of loans locked by Aspire in the fourth quarter of 2025.
kpis.description: Volume of $1.5 billion in loans locked by Aspire in Q4 2025, representing record quarterly production for the platform during its first full year of operations.
kpis.signal: Rapid acceleration of Aspire in expanded-credit and non-QM financing, reaching peak production in Q4.

kpis.name: Legacy asset dispositions
kpis.explanation: Total amount of legacy asset dispositions completed in 2025.
kpis.description: Amount of $1.2 billion in legacy asset dispositions completed in 2025, including outright sales, structured financings, and partnership transactions.
kpis.signal: Acceleration of Legacy Investments portfolio reduction to improve balance sheet flexibility and revenue profile.

kpis.name: Sequoia distribution activity
kpis.explanation: Total volume distributed by Sequoia through securitizations and whole loan sales.
kpis.description: Volume of $4.2 billion distributed by Sequoia in Q4 2025, comprised of approximately $3.0 billion in securitizations and $1.2 billion in whole loan sales, supporting rapid capital rotation.
kpis.signal: Distribution efficiency and rapid capital rotation supporting scalability and capital returns.

kpis.name: Aspire loan sales
kpis.explanation: Volume of loans sold by Aspire to institutional buyers.
kpis.description: Volume of $914 million in loan sales completed by Aspire in 2025 to various institutional buyers, including its first whole loan sale to a bank in Q4.
kpis.signal: Development of Aspire's distribution capabilities and preparation for launch of its securitization platform.

kpis.name: CoreVest joint venture transfers
kpis.explanation: Cumulative volume of loans transferred by CoreVest to its joint ventures.
kpis.description: Cumulative volume of $2.1 billion in loans transferred by CoreVest to its joint venture vehicles since strategy launch, underscoring the scale and capital efficiency achieved through this distribution channel.
kpis.signal: Success of CoreVest's joint venture strategy in improving capital efficiency and distribution.

kpis.name: Aspire seller network
kpis.explanation: Number of originators in Aspire's distribution network.
kpis.description: Aspire expanded its seller network to 123 originators in 2025, with 69% of volume sourced from originators who also transact with Sequoia, demonstrating synergies from the integrated platform approach.
kpis.signal: Rapid expansion of Aspire's seller network demonstrating benefits of integrated platform approach.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance ex-div dates.
kpis.signal: Regular Distribution

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.
kpis.signal: Shareholder Return Policy

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income (2021-2025). Source yfinance.
kpis.signal: Dividend Sustainability
